retrievalProfile.description: A profile silhouette of a person filled with a complex montage of urban scenes and figures against a stark white background.
excludeWhen: a simple single-image double exposure is requested
the background is not pure white
the silhouette is not in profile

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a dark profile silhouette of a man with dreadlocks, where the interior of the silhouette acts as a window into a multi-layered collage of street scenes, neon signs, and urban figures, set against a minimalist white void.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouette acts as a container for internal narrative imagery
High contrast between the dark silhouette edges and the white background
Juxtaposition of sharp vector typography and photographic collage
Vertical stacking of internal scenes within the human form
coreInvariants: The silhouette must be a side profile view
The background must remain a flat, solid white
Internal imagery must be a collage of multiple distinct scenes rather than one single photo

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central silhouette occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, defined profile of the face on the right side of the silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left logo, move to the profile face, then scan down through the internal collage elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central figure, creating a clean, modern look.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multicolor (internal collage elements including reds, yellows, and blues)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with varied saturation levels inside the silhouette.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and expressive script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky strokes with sharp serifs
Secondary text uses a fast, gestural handwriting style with long horizontal strokes
Integration of symbols (like currency signs) into the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the primary display text is replaced or modified with a currency symbol
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, industrial slab serif with a light, personal handwriting script.

preserve: The contrast between blocky and script styles

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the industrial, bold feel of the primary logo
Matches the gestural, handwritten feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a profile silhouette of a man with dreadlocks against a pure white background. Fill the interior of the silhouette with a vertical collage of urban photography, including street lights, people, and city storefronts.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a heavy, black slab-serif display font in the top-left corner and a light, black gestural script in the top-right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the silhouette a clear profile view?
Is the internal imagery a collage of multiple scenes?
Are the two text styles contrasting in weight?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the silhouette hair texture
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the silhouette is not transparent to the background
Check that the script text is legible despite its gestural nature
Verify the collage does not bleed outside the silhouette boundaries
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile Silhouette + Urban Montage Fill + Stark White Background + Polarized Typography
